notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded implementation of the official 2025 C++ RTI/encoding/HLAlogicalTime.h and RTI/encoding/HLAlogicalTimeInterval.h classes. IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.3 requires LogicalTime and LogicalTimeInterval abstract interfaces to support compact, opaque network representations and creation from those representations. These helpers therefore add no Umbra-defined time wire format: they delegate bytes to the logical-time factory selected by the supplied RTIambassador, retain that factory for the helper lifetime, and copy a value through that factory's decode path. Umbra's current supported factories are only HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time, each with a fixed eight-octet encoding. The standard factory interface does not report a decoded byte count, so decodeFrom is intentionally bounded to the current selected reference value's encodedLength(); it is not a generic third-party variable-width logical-time decoder. getOctetBoundary() returning one is an Umbra opaque-stream policy, not a universal custom-time layout claim. The tests use a private factory-returning ambassador shell; they do not prove a joined-federate getTimeFactory service, catalog result, JUnit sidecar result, package behavior, interoperability, or conformance. The direct Lab candidates retain exported clause-12.4/annex provenance although the reconstructed normative source is §12.3; RL-055 records that source-export drift.
